## module (10)

- [[qor_current]] - qor_current | id: qor_current - Current-thread and current-process abstractions; the platform supplies the implementation.
- [[qor_error]] - qor_error | id: qor_error - Raise errors of varying severity and handle them; the widest link line of the four flyers.
- [[qor_interception]] - qor_interception | id: qor_interception - Function-level interception framework for AOP; the leaf of the flyer set - three links in, one flyer out.
- [[qor_issue]] - qor_issue | id: qor_issue - Issue base classes and infrastructure; the where/when/what record both other flyers depend on.
- [[qor_log]] - qor_log | id: qor_log - Log raising and default handlers; the top of the flyer stack, and it reaches a framework lib.
- [[qor_module]] - qor_module | id: qor_module - Base static lib linked into every QOR module; carries the module tag and static-library chaining.
- [[qor_reporting]] - qor_reporting | id: qor_reporting - Forwarding reporting proxy with a fallback, so low-level libs can report without depending on qor_error.
- [[qor_text]] - qor_text | id: qor_text - String classes for UTF-8, UTF-16 and UCS4 plus code-page encodings; qor::String is UTF8String.
- [[qor_textshaping]] - qor_textshaping | id: qor_textshaping - Text layout and shaping for display; declared but not configured, so its judge cannot go green.
- [[qor_unicode]] - qor_unicode | id: qor_unicode - Unicode and UTF handling inside the text subsystem; the one text subdirectory that is configured.
